sloka: तन्न विश्वसितव्यं वो राक्षसानां रणाजिरे ।एतेनैवोपमानेन नित्यं जिह्मा हि राक्षसाः ।। ६.५०.५४ ।।।।
transliteration: tanna viśvasitavyaṁ vo rākṣasānāṁ raṇājire ।etenaivopamānena nityaṁ jihmā hi rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.50.54 ।।।।

translations.english: "Being so you should not trust Rakshasas. By this experience you know that Rakshasas are crooked."
